title: The Pedal's Unanswered Ascent
motif_identity: A short pitched contour begins on its home pitch, rises by whole step then semitone, drops by a fourth, rebounds by whole step, and turns down by semitone. Its rhythm is a compact opening gesture followed by a held, breath-bearing upper tone, a small rest, and a longer answering descent. The opening statement reaches a provisional destination; later complete phrases extend it, oppose it with an inverted-bearing counterline, and finally continue beyond the old held tone into a settled descent to D.
harmonic_debt: The work accumulates an A-based dominant obligation after the Neapolitan and diminished contradictions. It is intentionally carried through the climax and paid only at the opening of the final resolution section.
resolution_intent: A7 flat 9 resolves at the final section opening into D minor; the initial melodic contour then receives its altered consequence by continuing past its former suspended goal and descending to D. The last D-minor add-9 event confirms that the premise and counterargument now share the same tonal ground.

narrative_acts.cause: The initial D pedal grants identity but withholds harmonic certainty.
narrative_acts.consequence: The line can speak fully enough to be remembered, yet its ending remains structurally exposed.
narrative_acts.unresolved: Whether the upper resting point belongs to tonic completion or an impending departure.
narrative_acts.resolution_target: A provisional upper melodic resting point over D, not a cadence.

narrative_acts.cause: B-flat and G-minor colouring recast the premise from inside its own tonal field.
narrative_acts.consequence: The melodic continuation becomes a counterargument, and the 38-bar preparation makes departure consequential.
narrative_acts.unresolved: The D pedal still lacks a final bass-and-line agreement.
narrative_acts.resolution_target: A local descent that stops short of stable D-minor closure.

narrative_acts.cause: The premise is extended beyond its original horizon into F-major colour.
narrative_acts.consequence: E-flat-major contradiction and A7 flat 9 reveal that local repose cannot settle the D-minor question.
narrative_acts.unresolved: D returns, but only as aftermath rather than answer.
narrative_acts.resolution_target: A real local resting point in F, followed by redirection.

narrative_acts.cause: Premise and counterargument are made simultaneous rather than sequential.
narrative_acts.consequence: The melodic identity becomes active discourse; diminished compression proves its tones can be transformed by stepwise resolution.
narrative_acts.unresolved: The two lines still seek incompatible kinds of arrival.
narrative_acts.resolution_target: A changed D-minor recollection after direct chromatic resolution.

narrative_acts.cause: The counterargument is allowed a complete, generous sentence.
narrative_acts.consequence: Its credible local cadence makes the later return to D psychologically necessary rather than arbitrary.
narrative_acts.unresolved: Whether local consolation can replace tonal home.
narrative_acts.resolution_target: A local F/B-flat clearing that is explicitly insufficient.

narrative_acts.cause: The two sentence-types interleave and the pedal loses its innocence.
narrative_acts.consequence: A7 flat 9 becomes accumulated harmonic debt rather than a passing event.
narrative_acts.unresolved: The transformed continuation needs to pass through dominant pressure before it can descend to D.

narrative_acts.cause: The premise and counterargument fuse under the highest chromatic and dominant weight.
narrative_acts.consequence: The old provisional upper goal is carried beyond itself, preparing the final changed descent.
narrative_acts.unresolved: The sustained A-based relation demands an answer in D but does not yet receive one.
narrative_acts.resolution_target: Maximum confrontation, deliberately denied stable tonic.

narrative_acts.cause: The climax has exhausted the alternative harmonic claims and sustained dominant debt.
narrative_acts.consequence: D minor returns as consequence, not repetition; D minor 6 preserves memory of change before the final tonic release.
narrative_acts.unresolved: Only residual afterimage remains, not an active harmonic question.
narrative_acts.resolution_target: The original contour's transformed descent arrives on D within a settled tonic field.

chord_palette.label: D minor add 9 over C pedal

sections.name: I. Bearing the Question
sections.harmonic_direction: D minor is established through prolonged tonic bearing; the later G-minor colour widens the field without dislodging D as the shared anchor.
sections.motif_treatment: The premise states the complete opening thought rather than a fragment: the contour rises cautiously, folds inward, and reaches a provisional upper resting point that does not settle the D pedal beneath it.

harmonic_events.purpose: Establish the unresolved D-minor premise and its bearing tone.
Alter the pedal relation while preserving the opening harmonic material.
Open the first local phrase toward a darker neighbouring field.
Leave the premise suspended rather than cadenced.

sections.name: II. The Incomplete Reply
sections.harmonic_direction: The first 38-bar preparation completes here: D remains audible, but B-flat and G minor recast its upper tones as a question about whether the line belongs to tonic or predominant space.
sections.motif_treatment: A continuation extends the initial line beyond its first provisional destination. Its answer-like descent stops one degree short of secure closure, while a related lower counterargument insists on the pedal’s instability.

harmonic_events.purpose: Resume the suspended premise without resetting its story.
Let the counterargument occupy the relative-major edge of the field.
Deepen the question through predominant gravity.
Restore D as anchor while retaining the unclosed melodic implication.

sections.name: III. Departure and Local Ground
sections.harmonic_direction: The prepared arrival at bar 38 is a modal sidestep to F; C then redirects the music, and the foreign E-flat-major window resolves directly into A dominant by semitone motion before D returns.
sections.motif_treatment: The melody departs in a longer sentence: its rising premise is made more lyrical, then answered by a smoother descending continuation that reaches a local destination in F without resolving the original D-minor question.

harmonic_events.purpose: Make the first consequential departure and local melodic destination audible.
Turn the local answer outward instead of allowing it to become global resolution.
Introduce the declared Neapolitan colour as a concentrated contradiction.
Resolve E-flat to E and B-flat to A inside an intensified dominant window.
Return to D only as an incomplete consequence of the departure.

sections.name: IV. Encounter
sections.harmonic_direction: A pedal-derived D/A relation makes tonic less settled; diminished colour is immediately resolved into D minor, proving that the harmonic question can be redirected but not yet discharged.
sections.motif_treatment: The original contour now encounters its counterargument directly: one line sustains the former provisional goal while another continues past it. Their exchange changes the premise from hesitant inquiry into an active, contested proposition.

harmonic_events.purpose: Recast the tonic as a divided bass relation rather than a resting place.
Bring the counterargument into a dark predominant field.
Compress the opposing lines into the declared chromatic hinge.
Resolve every foreign diminished pitch by step into a D-minor scale tone.
Keep the transformed premise mobile rather than cadential.

sections.name: V. Counterargument's Clearing
sections.harmonic_direction: B-flat and F provide the clearest local repose of the work, yet the return through G minor prevents this repose from becoming the answer to D’s larger question.
sections.motif_treatment: A broad counterstatement takes priority over the opening line. It preserves the premise’s intervallic family but reverses its emotional bearing, landing clearly on a local goal before the original voice returns in altered perspective.

harmonic_events.purpose: State the counterargument’s temporary ground.
Give its full sentence a genuine but local resting point.
Turn the local cadence into renewed D-minor gravity.
Bring back the premise, now informed by the counterstatement.

sections.name: VI. Narrowing the Gate
sections.harmonic_direction: The harmonic field narrows from pedal ambiguity to dominant pressure. A7 flat 9 is held as an earned demand, not an automatic cadence, so D minor remains deferred.
sections.motif_treatment: The two prior sentences interleave rather than alternate. The opening contour is lengthened into a more decisive ascent; the counterline shadows it, then yields space for a newly consequential downward continuation.

harmonic_events.purpose: Resume the shared anchor in its most unstable pedal form.
Draw the interleaved lines into predominant pressure.
Expose the dominant problem without resolving it.
Maintain dominant debt through a shifted bass relation.

sections.name: VII. Confrontation and Climax
sections.harmonic_direction: This is the work's climax: chromatic compression, predominant force, and extended dominant bearing exceed the final section’s intensity. D is glimpsed but not granted stable tonic function until afterward.
sections.motif_treatment: The premise and counterargument are fused into their most expansive sentence. The former suspended upper note is carried through confrontation rather than withheld; its changed continuation falls through the line that will later become the audible answer.

harmonic_events.purpose: Make the last stable recollection of the counterargument before collision.
Force the field toward its dominant-side confrontation.
Present the Neapolitan contradiction at maximal structural weight.
Resolve the chromatic colour directly into dominant force, with E-flat moving to E and B-flat moving to A.
Sustain the unresolved dominant relation past the point where a routine cadence would occur.

sections.name: VIII. Answer and Aftermath
sections.harmonic_direction: The climax's A-based pressure resolves into D minor at the section opening. D minor 6 then retains the shared identity while changing its colour; the final D-minor add-9 return is a release rather than a restart.
sections.motif_treatment: The transformed return gives the melodic question its audible answer: the ascent no longer stops at the old provisional pitch, but continues through a calm descending consequence to D. The counterargument becomes supportive rather than oppositional, and the final phrase releases after its destination is unmistakable.

harmonic_events.purpose: Decisively resolve the sustained dominant debt and state the transformed D-minor return.
Let the answer breathe in a changed tonic colour rather than immediately ending.
Briefly recall the earlier pedal ambiguity as memory, now without threat.
Complete the final release on the original tonic identity, newly earned.

cast.role: Upper harmonic extension that progressively becomes an independent conversational counterline.

cast.role: Bearer of the opening folk-derived premise, its transformations, confrontation, and resolved final return.

cast.name: Cello motif answerer
cast.role: Motif-derived lower counterargument: initially destabilizing the premise, then becoming its supportive answer.

cast.name: Clarinet conversational line
cast.role: Independent agile conversational partner, introducing displaced continuations and chromatic replies.

cast.name: Contrabass pedal
cast.role: Low D-centered pedal authority and structural bass grounding, destabilized only where the harmonic argument requires it.

cast.name: Bassoon moving bass
cast.role: Pitched low-register propulsion that emerges after the opening as a mobile counterpart to the pedal bass.

cast.name: Marimba harmonic pulse
cast.role: Articulated harmonic pulse that clarifies changing harmonic pressure without replacing the sustained chord bodies.

cast.name: Timpani structural impulse
cast.role: Sparse structural low-percussion punctuation, intensifying into the climactic confrontation and withdrawing for the answer.

cast.name: Low orchestral percussion
cast.role: Independent low-percussion weight for encounter, narrowing, and climax; absent from the opening premise.

cast.name: Cymbal crisis color
cast.role: High-percussion color marking the tightening chromatic field and its climactic release.
